images.seen: 32 archaeological cultures in plausible regions (Green Sahara, Hoabinhian, Jomon, Ubaid, Aboriginal Australians and so on); Cliopatria has no shapes this early, so nothing to compare; no speckle, holes or out-of-region cells.

Ghassulian ran from Sinai to the Bekaa and the Damascus side (28 of 147 cells in Lebanon, Syria and Sinai), outside the page's range; Badarian at El-Badari (Asyut reach) and Faiyum-Merimde at Merimde Beni Salama look right.
identical to -4400 apart from the Ghassulian and Badarian cells that appeared in -4400; no jumps; Cliopatria empty.
after the patch Ghassulian is confined to Jordan, Israel and the Palestinian territories (119 cells); no Lebanon, Syria or Sinai cells.

issues.what: Ghassulian founding discs (Jordan-river 35 km band, Amman, Beer Sheva 70 km, Tel Aviv, Jericho) reach Lebanon (15 cells), Syria (11) and Sinai (2); the page gives the range as "today's Jordan, Israel and Palestinian territories" and names no site outside them. Keyframe cut to those three countries and a paired same-year loss event drops the 28 cells, so the keyframe snap does not appear.

Badarian culture (54 cells at El-Badari), Faiyum-Merimde (Faiyum Neolithic ends in -4400, Merimde keyframe -4400..-4200) and Pottery Neolithic Levant (ends -4400) hand over cleanly; the -4400 change count of 226 is explained by the three ledger events.

problems: ghassulian_-4400 spans -4400..-3800, so keyframe_overrides/0 (and the loss event only in -4400) also changes ghassulian in windows m4300-m4201 through m3900-m3801 (end anchor m4300 changes by 28 cells); the first window in order wins if a later window overrides the same keyframe, so those windows should agree or report it.
trial: conflicts 0 -> 0, keyframe snaps 0 -> 0, end anchor m4300: 28 cells change owner (Ghassulian to nobody); all 790 other windows' patch entries applied in the trial.
